EE-1000

EE-1000 Series

Intel Celeron N5105

extremeEdge|Fanless | Made by SNUC

Form

  1. Intel Celeron N5105
  2. Intel UHD Graphics
  3. Soldered LPDDR4 32GB Max Up to 2933MHz
  4. 256GB Primary storage (up to 2TB)
  5. 1x HDMI

Features

The first of its kind, NANO-BMC out-of-band management in a small form factor enables remote management of edge devices at the extremeEDGE. Remote access to hardware even when powered off (useful for troubleshooting). Increased uptime, faster problem resolution and reduced support costs. Improved power management and resource utilisation.

Made by SNUC.
